about: The untracked price files under database/ that code reads. Checked by backend/datafeed/store/manifest.py; keys are paths under database/. The files themselves are not in git (public repo; source terms unknown).

source.how: a one-off download to the developer machine (database/README.md); vendor, product and download date not recorded

ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.format: CSV with CRLF line ends. Line 1 is a header with a stray prefix: 'should contai<TICKER>,<DTYYYYMMDD>,<TIME>,<OPEN>,<HIGH>,<LOW>,<CLOSE>,<VOL>'. Then one 1-min bar per line: TICKER (XAUUSD),YYYYMMDD,HHMMSS,OPEN,HIGH,LOW,CLOSE,VOL; the time is the bar's open.
ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.timezone: UTC (research/vol_features/DATA_AUDIT_LONG.md: best shift 0 in every year where it can be identified; 2020-2023 equal the clean parquet close for close)
ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.known_issues: not sorted as stored; 1 duplicate timestamp and 1 bad OHLC row, both before 2020; usable years 2007-2023 by the audit's U1-U3 rules (DATA_AUDIT_LONG.md)

source.how: a one-off export (its script was never in git); reproduced exactly by tools/data/build_clean_parquet.py

cleaning_steps: read date + time as UTC (no shift)
keep rows with timestamp >= 2020-01-01 00:00 UTC (the first kept row is 2020-01-01 23:00)
sort by timestamp; the kept range has no duplicate timestamps and no bad OHLC bars, so nothing is dropped
columns timestamp (datetime64[ns, UTC]), open, high, low, close, volume (float64; VOL as is)
ohlcv_data/XAUUSD_1min_UTC_clean.parquet.verified: 2026-10-22: all 2,156,239 rows equal the XAUUSD.txt rows with the same timestamp in open, high, low, close and volume, and no XAUUSD.txt row in the range is missing; tools/data/build_clean_parquet.py reproduces content_sha256
